message: (Take a photo)

name: Shiori
message: "I figured this would at least make you flinch a little, but nope. Guess it still wasn't impactful enough."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, but I wasn't just doing this for laughs, okay?"

name: Shiori
message: "Remember how I pulled that rope out of nowhere yesterday? I started wondering how that even works."

name: Shiori
message: "A soul accessory... Just like the clothes we ghosts wear. Basically, a part of the soul itself."

name: Shiori
message: "Meaning, the soul's shape can change to some extent. Like how we can look like we're bleeding, or bend our limbs in weird directions."

name: Shiori
message: "So wouldn't that mean our accessories can change shape too? That's what I had in mind when I tried this."

name: Shiori
message: "And as you can see, the rope is now an axe."

name: Shiori
message: "Since I can make weapons now, I figured I might as well die spectacularly."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, maybe I *was* going for laughs..."

name: Shiori
message: "Wait, no, that's not it. I was seriously thinking—okay, maybe I should just stop talking now. "

name: Shiori
message: "Ta-dah, look. The axe is gone~!"

name: Shiori
message: "Ghosts really are strange, aren't they? I feel like I've gotten a little closer to the truth of the soul."

name: Shiori
message: "Not that it matters. Anyway, back on topic."

name: Shiori
message: "You know, I've been thinking nonstop about how exactly I died."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm pretty sure I died in that park. And I'm certain it wasn't suicide."

name: Shiori
message: "So by elimination, it was probably an accident, incident... or even a murder. That's why I tried dying like that."

name: Shiori
message: "But I guess it was unlikely I was killed by having my head split open with an axe. And honestly, I'd say it's safe to rule murder out."

name: Shiori
message: "Murder victims usually have their names released, right? But when we searched online, mine never came up."

name: Shiori
message: "Even if the case never went public, and my body was never found, it'd still be weird."

name: Shiori
message: "There should've been at least some reports saying that Kugayama Shiori went missing. But there weren't any."

name: Shiori
message: "If I'd been involved in some incident, my name should have shown up online in some way."

name: Shiori
message: "The fact that it didn't appear at all means it probably wasn't an incident."

name: Shiori
message: "Which leaves either an accident or natural causes."

name: Shiori
message: "I used to play in that park all the time with my little sister."

name: Shiori
message: "And knowing me, I probably went all out, enough to weird her out."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe I just tripped, hit my head the wrong way, and died."

name: Shiori
message: "What do you think? Makes the most sense, right?"
"Yes."
"No."

name: Shiori
message: "I know, right?"

name: Shiori
message: "To be honest, I kind of wanted you to deny it... Do I really seem that scatterbrained to you?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Oh well. My point is, it's very likely I just died from a minor accident."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh? Is that so?"

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe I'm actually calmer and more mature than I think. Thank you, my self-esteem just skyrocketed."

name: Shiori
message: "Even if I didn't trip, I still think it's very likely I just died from a minor accident."

name: Shiori
message: "If that's the case, then it's no surprise it never made the news. I'd say it's the most likely cause."

name: Shiori
message: "Although... something still keeps nagging at me..."

name: Shiori
message: "That little ghost girl, and the Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Case. Just thinking about them makes my heart feel restless."

name: Shiori
message: "Also... do you recall when I lost sight of that girl, and I mentioned hide and seek?"

name: Shiori
message: "I remembered... that I used to play hide and seek with my little sister a lot."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe seeing a child around her age stirred my memories. Or maybe that girl was actually—"

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry, never mind."

name: Shiori
message: "Anyway, I want to keep looking for her today."

name: Shiori
message: "With no leads to work on, we'll just have to take things one step at a time."

name: Shiori
message: "If we can find her, I'm sure we'll learn something... Or at least, that's what I want to believe."

name: Shiori
message: "But I also have this weird feeling in my chest... I'm not sure if it's a good sign or a bad one."

name: Shiori
message: "Being alone makes me uneasy, so having you here really helps. Anyway, I'll be counting on you again today."
